pillar: 6 — Paid media / performance marketing (creative production with pillar 15)
intents: I need ten fresh ads this week and I have no designer
make me static / image ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn
more like my winning ad — new hooks
my image ad got rejected — fix it
a header image or social graphic in our brand style
reads: brand brain: kit, products, learnings incl. do/dont/must rules — learn-my-brand / server research
claims sign-off marker and 'Claims you may use' facts (via the shared claims-gate atom) — learn-my-brand
approved campaign record: brief (Status: Approved), concepts — plan-campaign (campaign_read)
weekly performance read: reports/performance/<date>.md ('what to make next') — analyze-performance

request lines 'Rotation needed: for make-static-ads' / 'Fix needed: for make-static-ads' in ads/campaigns/<slug>/rotation-requests.md, and the health line of ads/campaigns/<slug>/state.md — run-paid-campaigns
own and competitor scraped ads — ads_template_read mine / competitor (server research)
kept product photos and 'Product imagery ready:' answers — make-product-photos

graphic request lines 'Graphic needed: for make-static-ads · …' in lifecycle/flows/<flow-slug>.md (email-lifecycle), social/calendar/<start-date>.md (run-organic-social), content/repurposed/<source-slug>/<date>.md and content/drafts/<date>-<slug>.md (make-content)
writes: lower-case creative tags (angle:a-nn, type, archetype, hook, stage, batch, test, offer-ends, claims, src, picked) — read by analyze-performance (angle ranking) and research-competitors (angle test status)
the human's picks: feedback rating happy + 'picked' tag + the batch file — read by run-paid-campaigns

batch file ads/batches/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md: per-ad copy (primary A/B, headline, description, CTA, destination), creative and render ids per ratio, angle/type, claims and policy lines, special-category flag, picks, test question, test structure with the stated budget, cut list, flags — run-paid-campaigns launches from it verbatim
'Product imagery needed: for make-product-photos · …' request lines in the batch file — answered by make-product-photos
'Rotation ready:' / 'Fix ready:' answers under run-paid-campaigns' request lines — read by run-paid-campaigns on its next run
'Graphic ready:' answer lines under sibling request lines — read by email-lifecycle, run-organic-social, make-content on their next run
render feedback with reason codes — read by the ad engine's quality loop
brand learnings through the shared save-learning atom, on the human's own words — read by every creative playbook
